through: Week 5 (last fully completed week). Week 6 is not complete: the Monday night game (WAS at SF, 8:15pm ET Oct 19) had not been played at fetch time, so Week 6 Thursday and Sunday results are NOT included in season/recent averages. Injury, role and news through Mon Oct 19 2026 ~5:15pm EDT.
scoring: PPR (FantasyPros stats pages, scoring=PPR). K and DST use FantasyPros scoring for those positions.
notes: season = total PPR points / games played in weeks 1-5 (summed from FantasyPros per-week stats pages, week=1..5, re-fetched Oct 19); recent = mean of the last up to 4 games the player appeared in (weeks 1-5), so bye weeks and missed games are skipped.
Players chosen by total PPR points in weeks 1-5, capped per position: QB 36, RB 75, WR 100, TE 36, K 32, DST 32.
Week 6 stats pages were fetched only to see who played on Thursday/Sunday (26 teams; CIN, DET, MIA, MIN on bye; WAS and SF play Monday). Week 6 points are not in any average.

health and news come from each player's FantasyPros news page (/nfl/news/<player>.php, latest items) plus the FantasyPros injury-news and player-news feeds (Fri Oct 16 to Mon Oct 19). Players with no injury report default to healthy, which means no report was found, not confirmed healthy. A player tagged questionable before Week 6 who then played in Week 6 is set to healthy and flagged.
role is steady unless a FantasyPros news item reports a change (starter benched, committee, injury replacement, release); the reason is in flags. No snap-count data was pulled.
DST entries were not checked for news; they are healthy/steady by default.
Team is the team shown on FantasyPros for the latest week the player appeared, except released/waived players, set to FA.
sources: https://www.fantasypros.com/nfl/stats/{qb,rb,wr,te,k,dst}.php?scoring=PPR&range=week&week=6 (only to check which Week 6 games were played; not averaged)
